question: What claim is being made about the foregoing letter-elements when they are said to have a prescribed usage rather than standing as a mere list?
premises: A set of elements has been specified in the preceding verses.
That set is not left unassigned.
It is here marked as having a prescribed usage.
inference: The elements specified above are intended for prescribed application, not for mere enumeration.
uncertainties: The exact application is not specified in this single-token verse.
The scope of prayogaḥ must be determined from the surrounding sequence.
plain_english: This is the prescribed usage of the foregoing.
